## Overview

This project uses a reproducible R pipeline to clean and validate a
[fixed source snapshot]({{< var dataset.zenodo_record_url >}}) and produce the
[**{{< var processed_dataset.title >}}**]({{< var processed_dataset.url >}}), a
curated dataset of fully released paid Steam games from
**{{< var analysis.start_year >}}–{{< var analysis.end_year >}}** with at least
**10,000 reviews**.

The *exploratory data analysis*, the *statistical analysis, including model building and evaluation*, and the *Italian and English reports*, covering methods, results, limitations, and reproducibility, are currently under development.

## Quick start

The project requires **R {{< var environment.r_minimum_version >}} or later**
and **Quarto {{< var environment.quarto_minimum_version >}} or later**.
**{{< var environment.tex_distribution >}}**, or another compatible TeX
distribution, is needed only for PDF reports.

```powershell
Rscript setup.R
Rscript main.R
```

- [`setup.R`](setup.R) restores the packages recorded in
  [`renv.lock`](renv.lock).
- [`main.R`](main.R) runs the pipeline.
